prompts.g00-glassblower: integrated_multimodal_description: A glassblower turns a glowing orange bulb at the end of a long pipe, then blows and shapes it with wet newspaper; steam bursts off the paper. Medium shot in a dark workshop lit by the furnace. overall_soundscape: The furnace roar, a sharp hiss of steam, the pipe rolling on a steel rail, a short exhale. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g01-skate-bowl: integrated_multimodal_description: A skateboarder drops into a concrete bowl, carves up the far wall and grabs the board mid-air before landing. Low wide angle that whips to follow the rider, bright overcast light. overall_soundscape: Urethane wheels rumbling on concrete, the sharp clack of the tail, a moment of silence in the air, then a landing thud and cheers. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g02-bakery-dawn: integrated_multimodal_description: In a bakery before opening, a baker scores a row of risen loaves with a blade and slides the tray into a stone oven; flour dust floats in a shaft of window light. Slow push-in. overall_soundscape: The blade slicing dough, a wooden peel scraping stone, the oven door clanging shut, a kettle starting to whistle. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g03-harbor-storm: integrated_multimodal_description: Fishing boats pitch at their moorings in a small harbor as a storm rolls in; spray bursts over the breakwater and gulls fight the wind. Handheld shot from the pier, grey-green light. overall_soundscape: Howling wind, waves slamming the breakwater, rigging clanking against masts, gulls crying. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g04-tango-hall: integrated_multimodal_description: Two dancers tango across a wooden floor in a dim hall with a mirrored wall; their legs flick and hook in time, a dress hem sweeps the floor. Tracking shot at waist height. overall_soundscape: Heels striking wood in rhythm, fabric swishing, a bandoneon melody from a small band in the corner. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g05-greenhouse-rain: integrated_multimodal_description: Rain streams down the glass roof of a greenhouse while a gardener mists orchids with a brass sprayer; droplets bead on broad leaves. Soft diffused light, slow dolly past the rows. overall_soundscape: Rain drumming on glass, the spray hiss, water dripping from leaf tips, a distant thunder roll. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g06-freight-crossing: integrated_multimodal_description: A long freight train thunders through a rural level crossing at dusk; the gates are down, red lights blink, a pickup waits with its headlights on. Static shot from beside the road, cars blur past. overall_soundscape: A horn blast, the heavy rhythmic clatter of wheels on rail joints, the crossing bell ringing, wind wake after the last car. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g07-calligraphy: integrated_multimodal_description: Overhead close-up of a brush painting a large Chinese character on rice paper; the bristles splay and the ink bleeds slightly into the fibers. Steady top-down shot, warm desk lamp. overall_soundscape: The brush dragging on paper, the soft tap of the brush on the ink stone, a wall clock ticking. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g08-sheepdog-hill: integrated_multimodal_description: A border collie races in a wide arc across a green hillside, gathering a flock of sheep that bunch and turn together; the shepherd whistles from a gate. Wide tracking shot, bright wind-swept afternoon. overall_soundscape: Sharp whistles, dozens of hooves on turf, bleating, the dog panting as it passes close to the camera. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g09-night-kitchen-flambe: integrated_multimodal_description: A chef tilts a pan over a gas flame and the sauce ignites in a tall blue-orange flare, lighting the steel kitchen; he shakes the pan and the flame dies down. Medium close-up, fast motion. overall_soundscape: The gas burner hiss, a whoomp as the alcohol catches, sizzling, pans clattering in the background. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g10-canoe-mangrove: integrated_multimodal_description: A canoe glides through a narrow mangrove channel; paddle strokes ripple the dark water and roots arch overhead, sunlight flickering through the canopy. Forward POV from the bow. overall_soundscape: Paddle dips and drips, water lapping the hull, insects buzzing, a heron taking off with heavy wingbeats. non_diegetic_music: None.
prompts.g11-blizzard-bus-stop: integrated_multimodal_description: People huddle under a bus shelter in a night blizzard; snow streaks sideways through the streetlight and a bus emerges from the whiteout with its wipers going. Static wide shot. overall_soundscape: Wind gusting, snow hissing against the shelter glass, the bus engine growing louder, a door folding open with a pneumatic sigh. non_diegetic_music: None.
